summary: WPP plc filed a Form 6-K containing its First Quarter 2026 Trading Update. The filing is a routine business update and does not disclose any M&A, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change. It consists primarily of forward-looking statements and risk factors. There are no deal terms, prices, premiums, or dates associated with a special situation. The filing is a standard periodic report by a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16.
